entryPointReview: The actual source caller is apply.c doapply selecting the CREAM_PIE, then use_cream_pie splits a carried stack through mkobj.c splitobj. The JS unpaid default now calls the whole synchronous shk.c splitbill port immediately after parent quantity reduction and child creation, before copy_oextra, timers, and light handling; an explicit hooks.splitBill provider still takes precedence. splitbill resolves the active hero shop using state-local shop_keeper and inhishop, finds the parent through onbill, decrements the active bill quantity, then either clears child.unpaid at BILLSZ or appends a same-price child row. The real generated-shop test first produces the original missing-child-bill refusal in costly_alteration/bill_dummy_object, and after the fix completes doapply with the parent billed at quantity one and a used-up child dummy bill preserving total debt. Scoped controls exercise the full-table clear and explicit hook precedence. This is focused source-parity runtime-pending evidence, not full source certification or gameplay recording parity. The linked correction also preserves the source non-silent onbill boundary: an unpaid parent without a row raises the existing UnsupportedShopError before bill table/child mutation; this is captured by a dedicated control red on the prior delivery and green after the correction.

functions.name: splitbill
functions.sourceReview: Read the complete upstream shk.c splitbill body (3623–3658). It selects shop_keeper(*u.ushops), requires an in-shop keeper, finds the parent bill row with onbill, emits the source diagnostics for missing/invalid bill quantities, decrements parent bquan by the child quantity, and then clears child.unpaid when billct == BILLSZ or appends the child row with child oid/quantity, useup false, and the original unit price before incrementing billct. The JS port preserves this order and state-local APIs. The source-mandated onbill call is nonsilent (FALSE); the port now uses onbill(obj, shopkeeper, false), preserving the existing UnsupportedShopError refusal if an unpaid parent has no active bill row before splitbill changes either billing row or child state.
